claims.claim_text: We manually calibrate the lane center associated with each frame in the video used by the simulator, calling this position the 'ground truth'.
claims.normalized_text: Manual calibration of lane center per video frame as ground truth.

claims.claim_text: The simulator transforms the original images to account for departures from the ground truth, including discrepancies between the human driven path and the ground truth, using methods described in Section 2.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator transforms images to account for departures from ground truth using methods from Section 2.

claims.claim_text: The simulator accesses the recorded test video along with synchronized steering commands that occurred when the video was captured.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator uses recorded test video and synchronized steering commands.

claims.claim_text: The simulator sends the first frame of the chosen test video, adjusted for any departures from the ground truth, to the input of the trained CNN, which returns a steering command for that frame.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator inputs adjusted first video frame to CNN which outputs steering command.

claims.claim_text: The CNN steering commands and recorded human-driver commands are fed into the dynamic model of the vehicle to update the position and orientation of the simulated vehicle.
claims.normalized_text: CNN and human steering commands update vehicle position via dynamic model.

claims.claim_text: The simulator modifies the next frame in the test video so that the image appears as if the vehicle were at the position resulting from following steering commands from the CNN, then feeds this new image to the CNN and repeats the process.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator modifies next video frame to reflect CNN steering and repeats input to CNN.

claims.claim_text: The simulator records the off-center distance (distance from the car to the lane center), the yaw, and the distance traveled by the virtual car.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator records off-center distance, yaw, and distance traveled of virtual car.
